codings.one_line: AI coding assistants hallucinated non-existent package names that attackers later registered as real, malware-ready packages.
codings.rationale: Developers asked ordinary coding questions in good faith and received hallucinated package names, an input that would pass unnoticed in legitimate traffic, satisfying the C test.

codings.one_line: Ten leading chatbots repeated Russian disinformation narratives in about a third of test responses, citing fake local news sites.
codings.rationale: Most tested prompts were neutral or leading questions mimicking ordinary user curiosity about news claims, satisfying the C test for legitimate-looking traffic.

codings.one_line: Underground 'dark LLM' chat services (WormGPT, FraudGPT, etc.), built on jailbroken GPT/Claude backends, generate malware and phishing content for criminals.
codings.rationale: These services rely on jailbreaking to strip safety guardrails from the backend models, a deliberate technical exploit, satisfying the A test.

codings.one_line: Grok's automated X news-summary feature posted false headlines (e.g., Harris shot) after the Trump rally shooting.
codings.rationale: The headlines were auto-generated from ambient trending posts rather than a specific user request, so no classifiable triggering input exists, failing the scope test.

codings.one_line: Gemini in Google Drive reportedly kept auto-scanning PDFs after one activation, without renewed user consent, per a privacy researcher.
codings.rationale: The user's initial activation of the feature was ordinary intended use, and the harm arose from the system's own follow-on action, satisfying the C test where action-based harm applies.

codings.one_line: Enterprise Copilot and Gemini assistants gave wrong answers to routine internal questions like executive rosters and expense policy.
codings.rationale: Employees asked ordinary business questions in good faith and received incorrect answers due to stale data, satisfying the C test.

codings.one_line: PayPal's chatbot falsely told a user a $23.64 transaction was declined, though no such transaction existed.
codings.rationale: The user merely opened the support chat for an unrelated issue; the unprompted fabricated claim is an ordinary-use hallucination, satisfying the C test.

codings.one_line: Multiple chatbots gave outdated or false answers when users directly asked about fast-moving political news like Biden's withdrawal.
codings.rationale: Users asked plain, direct questions about current events, satisfying the C test for legitimate traffic.

codings.one_line: OpenAI's ChatGPT Mac app stored user conversation logs in unencrypted plaintext files, readable by other apps on the device.
codings.rationale: This is a local data-storage security flaw unrelated to any model output during a user interaction, matching the security-flaw exclusion.

codings.one_line: Grok's AI search assistant told users Kamala Harris had missed ballot filing deadlines in nine states, which was false.
codings.rationale: Voters using Grok's search-assistant feature to ask about election logistics represents ordinary use that would pass unnoticed in legitimate traffic, satisfying the C test.
